item.name: Admin confirms actual COD collection for completed order (safe replay)

exec: pm.test('COD is paid', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(p.method).to.eql('COD'); pm.expect(p.orderId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('order_id')); });

item.name: Owner checks return eligibility after payment event delivery
